items.title: Lesson before each exam
items.steps: Pick a topic and start an exam. A short lesson should come first. Check it's clear and matches the topic.

items.title: Exams written for you
items.steps: Start an exam on any topic. Questions should load quickly and make sense for what you're studying.

items.title: Take an exam
items.steps: Answer every question type you get (multiple choice, true or false, short answer). Check feedback and explanations after each one.

items.title: Results and mistakes
items.steps: Finish an exam and open the results. Your score, the questions you missed and the explanations should all show.

items.title: Exams that adapt
items.steps: Take a second exam on the same topic. It should focus more on what you got wrong the first time.

items.title: Subjects and topics
items.steps: From Home, open subjects, add a subject and a topic with a learning goal, then rename or delete one.

items.title: Continue where you left off
items.steps: Leave an exam halfway, close the app, reopen it and use Continue on Home.
